paite: Bangchidan a Toupa'n ahehna a Zion tanu meipi a tuam ahia! Israel kilawmna van a kipan lei ah apaikheta a, aheh ni in akhe ngakna atheigige kei hi.
heading: TOUPA'N Jerusalem Agawtna
english: How has the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger! He has cast down from heaven to the earth the beauty of Israel, And hasn’t remembered his footstool in the day of his anger.

paite: Jakob tenna tengteng Toupa'n anawmvalh a, ahehpih kei; ahehna ah Judah tanu kulh hatte alaichim a, lei toh kilual in akoih hi; gam leh huai a vaihawmte ahihninta hi.
english: The Lord has swallowed up all the habitations of Jacob, and has not pitied: He has thrown down in his wrath the strongholds of the daughter of Judah; He has brought them down to the ground; he has profaned the kingdom and its princes.

paite: Aheh mahmahna ah Israel kii tengteng asattan a; melma ma a kipan akhut taklam alakikta; meikuang, kimvel hulbei bang in Jakob akangmangta hi.
english: He has cut off in fierce anger all the horn of Israel; He has drawn back his right hand from before the enemy: He has burned up Jacob like a flaming fire, which devours all around.

paite: Melma bang in athalpeu alai a, gal bang in akhut taklam toh adingh a, mit a ding a etnophuaite tengteng athat a; Zion tanu puanin ah meikuang bang in athangpaihna asungbua hi.
english: He has bent his bow like an enemy, he has stood with his right hand as an adversary, Has killed all that were pleasant to the eye: In the tent of the daughter of Zion he has poured out his wrath like fire.

paite: Toupa'n melma bang ahong hi, Israel anawmvalhta; a-inpi tengteng anawmvalh vek a, akulh muanhuaite ahihseta; Judah tanu ah suunna leh kahna apungsak hi.
english: The Lord has become as an enemy, he has swallowed up Israel; He has swallowed up all her palaces, he has destroyed his strongholds; He has multiplied in the daughter of Judah mourning and lamentation.

paite: Huan hileh kilawm bang in, hiamgamtak in abiakbuk alamang a; akikhopna mun ahihseta; TOUPA'N kikhawm thupi leh Sabbath Zion ah mangngilh in a-omsak a, ahehna thangpaihna in kumpipa leh siampu amusit hi.
english: He has violently taken away his tabernacle, as if it were of a garden; he has destroyed his place of assembly: Yahweh has caused solemn assembly and Sabbath to be forgotten in Zion, Has despised in the indignation of his anger the king and the priest.

paite: Toupa'n amaitam apaimang a, amun siangthou akih a, a-inpi kulhbaangte melmate khut ah apeta hi; kikhop thupi ni bang in TOUPA insung ah thawm anei uhi.
english: The Lord has cast off his altar, he has abhorred his sanctuary; He has given up into the hand of the enemy the walls of her palaces: They have made a noise in the house of Yahweh, as in the day of a solemn assembly.

paite: Zion tanu kulhbaang TOUPA'N suksiat atumta; akhauzan a, hihse lou ding in akhut ala kei hi; himahleh leichian leh kulhbaang akapsak a; akigawp tuak uhi.
english: Yahweh has purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Zion; He has stretched out the line, he has not withdrawn his hand from destroying; He has made the rampart and wall to lament; they languish together.

paite: Akongpite lei ah atum ua; akalhna chiangte hihsia in akuaitan hi; dan omlouhna namte lak ah akumpipa leh alalte a-om uh; ahi, TOUPA a kipan azawlneite'n meng amu kei uhi.
english: Her gates are sunk into the ground; he has destroyed and broken her bars: Her king and her princes are among the nations where the law is not; Yes, her prophets find no vision from Yahweh.

paite: Leitung ah Zion tanu upate atu ua, apau kei uh; aluzang ua leivui akhi ua; sai-ip puan asilh uhi; Jerusalem nungak siangthoute'n lei lam ah alu uh akun uhi.
english: The elders of the daughter of Zion sit on the ground, they keep silence; They have cast up dust on their heads; they have clothed themselves with sackcloth: The virgins of Jerusalem hang down their heads to the ground.

paite: Khitui in ka mitte azuau a, ka lungsim amangbang hi, leitung ah ka sin buakkhiak in a-om a, ka mite tanu siatna ziak in khopi kongzingte a naupang tuailaite leh nawi ne laite asihbup ziak un.
english: My eyes do fail with tears, my heart is troubled; My liver is poured on the earth, because of the destruction of the daughter of my people, Because the young children and the infants swoon in the streets of the city.

paite: Anute uh kiang ah, buh-le-bal leh uain koi a om ahia? achi ua. Khopi kongzingte miliamte bang a asihbup lai un, anute uh angsung a akha uh sunbuak a a-om lai in.
english: They tell their mothers, Where is grain and wine? When they swoon as the wounded in the streets of the city, When their soul is poured out into their mothers’ bosom.

paite: Na kiang ah bang ka theisak dia? Nang toh bang ka teh dia, Aw Jerusalem tanu? Aw Zion tanu siangthou, ka hon lungmuan theihna ding in, bang toh ka hon kikimsak dia? Na siatna lah tuipi bang in athupi ngal a; kua'n nang ahon hihdam thei dia?
english: What shall I testify to you? what shall I liken to you, daughter of Jerusalem? What shall I compare to you, that I may comfort you, virgin daughter of Zion? For your breach is great like the sea: who can heal you?

paite: Na zawlneite'n bangmah lou leh haina nang a ding in mengmuh in amu ua; na koltanna pi nawn ding in, na gitlouhna amukhe kei uh; himahleh bangmah lou puakgik leh pimang a omna ziakte nang hon muhsak uh.
english: Your prophets have seen for you false and foolish visions; They have not uncovered your iniquity, to bring back your captivity, but have seen for you false oracles and causes of banishment.

paite: Hon paikheng tengteng in nang akhut uh ahon betkhum ua; Jerusalem tanu akikoukhum ua; alu uh asinkhum uh, hiai khopi kilawmna bukim, leitung pumpi a nopsakna, achih uh ahi maw? achi uhi.
english: All that pass by clap their hands at you. They hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Jerusalem, saying, Is this the city that men called The perfection of beauty, The joy of the whole earth?

paite: Nang siatna ding in na melmate tengteng in lianpi in akam uh aka ua; hiai ni i ngakngak uh ahi mahmah ve; i mukheta a, i muta uh.
english: All your enemies have opened their mouth wide against you; They hiss and gnash the teeth; they say, We have swallowed her up; Certainly this is the day that we looked for; we have found, we have seen it.

paite: TOUPA'N alunggeli ahihtangtungta, nidanglai a athupiak ahihtangtung a; apaita, ahehpih kei; na tung a melma akipaksak a, na galte kii atawisangta hi.
english: Yahweh has done that which he purposed; he has fulfilled his word that he commanded in the days of old; He has thrown down, and has not pitied: He has caused the enemy to rejoice over you; he has exalted the horn of your adversaries.

paite: TOUPA kiang ah alungtang akikou a; Aw Zion tanu kulhbaang, sun leh zan in khitui luipi bang in luangsak in; khawl kipe ke'nla; na mit khawlsak ke'n.
english: Their heart cried to the Lord: wall of the daughter of Zion, let tears run down like a river day and night; Give yourself no respite; don’t let the apple of your eye cease.

paite: Thou in, zan in kikou in, anvente kipatna ah; TOUPA mai ah tui bang in na lungtang sungkhia in; na ta tuailaite hinna a ding in amah lam ah na khutte liktou in, kongzingte ah an ngawl in abahgawp uhi.
english: Arise, cry out in the night, at the beginning of the watches; Pour out your heart like water before the face of the Lord: Lift up your hands toward him for the life of your young children, that faint for hunger at the head of every street.

paite: Aw TOUPA, en inla, ngai in, hichibang a na hihna; numeite'n agah uh ane ding uam, khut a oih a om naupangte? TOUPA mun siangthou sung ah siampu leh zawlnei thah a-om ding uh hia?
english: Look, Yahweh, and see to whom you have done thus! Shall the women eat their fruit, the children that are dandled in the hands? Shall the priest and the prophet be killed in the sanctuary of the Lord?

paite: Kongzingte a leitual ah tuailaite leh putekte alum ua; namsau in ka nungak siangthoute leh ka tangvalte apuk uh; na heh ni in amaute na that a; na that a, na hehpih kei hi.
english: The youth and the old man lie on the ground in the streets; My virgins and my young men are fallen by the sword: You have killed them in the day of your anger; you have slaughtered, and not pitied.

paite: Kikhawmpi thupi lai bang in, mun chih ah a-unaute na sam a, TOUPA heh ni in kuamah suakta hiam, om hiam a-om kei; huai ka dontei a ka khoilette ka melma in anegaita hi.
english: You have called, as in the day of a solemn assembly, my terrors on every side; There was none that escaped or remained in the day of Yahweh’s anger: Those that I have dandled and brought up has my enemy consumed.
